_about: P-01: every mtdi CLI command and every studio API route, with where the owner uses it in the studio. 'studio' names the control or card (its words must appear in the studio's source); 'hidden' says why it stays out of the interface; 'missing' says what still has to be built. tests/test_feature_map.py keeps this complete.

anomalies.missing: anomaly detection over a recording: needs a recordings view

store.missing: local and cloud storage: put, get, list, backup, restore

calibrate.missing: fit a calibration from a CSV of readings (the studio has only the two-point form)

aether.missing: guides, context notes and the hours-wasted counter from code comments

new.missing: create a project from the template

create.missing: the project wizard with GitHub, Vercel, Notion and MATLAB

packet.hidden: debug output of the headless runner

adopt.hidden: developer tool: copies MTDI into another repository

publish.missing: deploy to Vercel or open MATLAB for a project (only the Notion report upload is in the studio)

matlab.missing: open MATLAB on a project with a starter script

/api/camera-consent.studio: Ask again before sending camera frames

/api/camera/frame.hidden: single camera frame for tools and tests

/api/d4/filters.missing: filter design and comparison on the live channel 1 signal

/api/diagnostics.hidden: health endpoint for the self-test and monitoring

/api/history.hidden: machine interface: the charts read history inside the studio

/api/instrument.hidden: machine interface: the live packet the pages already show

/api/performance.hidden: the page reports its own frame timing here
